Class AbsFactory

java.lang.Object
ry.ms.AbsFactory
Direct Known Subclasses:
PostgresFactory
public abstract class AbsFactory extends Object
Abstract Factory for creating Data Access Object DAO instances. This pattern allows for creating families of related objects without specifying their concrete classes.
